title: XELOX Plus Apatinib vs XELOX as Post-operative Chemotherapy in Locally Advanced Gastric Signet Ring Carcinoma
brief_summary: This is a randomized, multicenter, controlled study to compared the Efficacy and Safety of XELOX combined with Apatinib versus XELOX as post-operative chemotherapy in locally advanced gastric signet ring carcinoma with D2 dissection.
